Material & care

010203

A few good questions

Can I buy Pollen?

Pollen is a fictional design concept, so the pieces are not available to buy.

How do the pieces fit together?

Think modular by arrangement: the tray, cup and riser are separate objects to place beside one another. They do not snap, lock or magnetically connect. Bring them into a cluster or spread them across your desk as your work changes.

What works on a very small desk?

Start with the Pocket Tray for loose essentials, or the Stem Cup if pens take up most of your space. Put your chosen piece toward the back or side and keep your main working area open. You do not need the whole collection.

How would I care for the pieces?

The imagined routine is a gentle wipe with a soft, damp cloth, followed by drying. Avoid soaking, harsh cleaners and heat. These suggestions describe the concept; final care instructions would depend on material testing.
